caption: The drawing features a rectangular, wooden box with a hinged lid and a thick, twisted rope handle attached to the top. The wood is depicted in shades of brown with visible grain texture, and the surface of the box is covered with multiple circular holes of varying sizes on the lid and all visible sides. The front and left edges of the box are accentuated by four turned wooden columns, two on each corner, which are rounded and shaped with symmetrical bulges. The box sits on a broad base with a beveled edge. In the lower right corner of the composition, there is a smaller, black-and-white sketch of the same object, showing similar details in line drawing style. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Foot Warmer
